text: はないち　もんめ　して　あそんでる　わけじゃ　ないよ　ちゃんと　たたかうもん
note: Hana Ichi Monme is a traditional Japanese children's game in which two rows of children hold hands, face each other and sing while taking players from the other side; the twins standing side by side look like they are playing it. The English game dropped the reference and says only that they may look silly standing there.
claim: Hana Ichi Monme is a traditional Japanese children's game played by two rows of children holding hands and facing each other, singing and taking players from the other team.

check.quote: Players split into two groups, and the members of each group hold hands, so that the teams face each other in two lines... The winner goes back to his team, and they discuss who the team wants to add from the other team.
